title: Ralph Cockpit UI in Algent
repo_context: Algent is a React + Vite UI with a Tauri wrapper; cockpit must be local-only and file-contract driven.

stories.title: Add Cockpit entry point and view switch
acceptance_criteria: A cockpit button/link labeled "Cockpit" or "Ralph Cockpit" appears on the home view
Clicking the cockpit entry point renders a cockpit view with a clear heading
There is a way to return to the original home view without a full reload
stories.notes: Keep changes minimal; no full routing refactor.

stories.title: Cockpit page skeleton layout
acceptance_criteria: A dedicated cockpit component renders a sidebar, main detail panel, and control/events area placeholders
Cockpit layout uses existing HUD style tokens (colors/spacing/typography)
stories.notes: Keep the layout calm and operator-focused.

stories.title: Cockpit data client interface with mock provider
acceptance_criteria: A typed client module exposes functions for listing repos, listing runs, reading run artifacts, and writing control signals
Cockpit consumes this client and renders mock run data in the UI
stories.notes: Keep mock data aligned with Ralph file contracts.

stories.title: Repo selection and run list UI
acceptance_criteria: User can select a repo from the cockpit sidebar
Run list updates when a repo is selected
Selected run is visibly highlighted and stored in state
stories.notes: No filesystem access yet; use client data.

stories.title: Run detail panels for state and docs
acceptance_criteria: Run state panel displays fields from mock run.json (status, phase, iteration, timestamps)
Docs panel renders PRD/progress text and story list from mock prd.json
stories.notes: Handle missing fields with clear placeholders.

stories.title: Control panel wiring to control.json client
acceptance_criteria: Control panel displays current control flags (pause, stop_soft, stop_hard, skip_iteration, review_now, review_next)
Toggle and one-shot actions call the client update method and reflect state updates for the same fields
stories.notes: One-shot actions (skip_iteration, review_now, review_next) must reset after simulated consume.

stories.title: Events tail viewer
acceptance_criteria: Events panel shows the most recent lines from mock events.ndjson
User can refresh or auto-follow to see new lines
stories.notes: Keep the list performant (limit to recent N lines).

stories.title: Engine launch panel and command generator
acceptance_criteria: Panel allows choosing driver and git isolation toggle
Generated command includes run id and engine path
Command string is displayed clearly for copy/paste
stories.notes: Use `C:\\projects\\ralph-engine` as the default engine path.
